status_notice: UNEXECUTED TEMPLATE. NO LAUNCH IS AUTHORIZED. Every result is not-run until the step is actually performed on an approved build. Copy to a private location before filling; never put private absolute paths, game bytes, assets or credentials in the record.

steps.title: Record build identity, platform and owned inputs
steps.preconditions: All readiness gates (source link, CRT/TLS, ABI, resource, provider) are closed; the readiness report was reviewed; written approval for this build is referenced in record.approval_reference.
procedure: Copy this template to a PRIVATE location outside the repository and work only in the copy.
Fill record, prepared_by (real model/tool attribution of who fills the record; do not infer it) and date.

Using a read-only hashing tool, record executable_sha256 and executable_size_bytes of <private-built-exe>; record source_commit, source_branch, build recipe, toolchain and readiness report references.
Fill platform and owned_inputs (installation version, data files used, add-ons/localization, access arrangement) without private paths, game bytes, assets or credentials.
Run the validator on the copy and confirm it reports no problems.
steps.expected: Identity, platform and inputs are recorded with placeholders only; validator reports no problems; nothing was launched.
steps.cleanup_rollback: No game or system state changed. If the record was filled in the wrong place, move it to the private location and securely delete the stray copy.

steps.title: Back up existing config/saves and confirm isolation
steps.preconditions: Identity step passed. You know (privately) where existing user configuration and saves live; those locations are not written into this record.
procedure: Copy (never move) existing user configuration and saves to a private backup location outside the repository; record only a backup reference.
Prepare <isolated-config-and-saves> as a new, empty location separate from every existing user location; no junctions, links or asset copies.
Record the isolation mechanism in launch.arguments / launch.environment_changes; confirm it cannot resolve to existing user config or saves.
Take a baseline hash of the original game executable and a listing/hash baseline of the existing user config and saves (kept privately).
Confirm <verified-dll-providers> lists only vetted providers, the original game executable is not a runtime provider, and no Steam stub, protection bypass or credentials are involved.
Set isolation.existing_user_config_and_saves_backed_up to true only after verifying the backup is readable.
steps.expected: A verified backup exists; the isolated location is empty and separate; baselines are taken; provider policy is recorded.
steps.cleanup_rollback: Nothing in the existing configuration or saves was modified. If anything was changed by mistake, restore it from the backup copy before continuing; delete the empty isolated location if abandoning the run.

steps.title: Process starts and a window appears
steps.preconditions: Backup and isolation passed; explicit approval is recorded; launch.application_directory_placeholder and launch.working_directory_placeholder are filled as separate fields; a time limit is chosen in advance and recorded in notes.
procedure: Start <private-built-exe> once from the recorded application directory with the recorded working directory, arguments and environment.
Observe whether the process starts and a top-level window appears within the time limit.
Do not interact with menus or gameplay in this step.
Capture a screenshot or log excerpt as evidence; list any files written.
steps.expected: Process starts without crash dialog, loader or missing-DLL error; a window appears; writes (if any) land only in <isolated-config-and-saves>.
steps.cleanup_rollback: If the process hangs or fails, end only that process by normal OS means and mark the step fail or blocked. Confirm no stray processes remain; reset <isolated-config-and-saves> to its empty baseline; do not touch the backup.

steps.title: Clean exit straight from startup
steps.preconditions: launch-to-window passed and the process is still running.
procedure: Request exit using the normal window close or system exit path; do not use forced termination.
Record the process exit code and whether it exited within the time limit.
Confirm no lingering processes, no crash dialog and no writes outside <isolated-config-and-saves>.
steps.expected: Process exits cleanly within the time limit with the expected exit code; no lingering processes or crash reports.
steps.cleanup_rollback: If the process did not exit, end only that process by normal OS means and record fail. Reset <isolated-config-and-saves> to its empty baseline unless later steps need its contents.

steps.title: Main menu is responsive
steps.preconditions: clean-exit-from-startup passed; relaunch uses the same recorded arguments, working directory and isolation.
procedure: Relaunch <private-built-exe> as recorded.
Wait for the main menu; move focus with keyboard and mouse across items; open and back out of a sub-menu.
Do not change settings other than inside the isolated profile; do not start gameplay yet.
Capture a screenshot and note any input lag, freezes or missing text/graphics.
steps.expected: Main menu renders; input moves focus and activates items without freezing; back/escape works.
steps.cleanup_rollback: Leave the menu and exit cleanly if possible, otherwise end only the test process by normal OS means. Reset <isolated-config-and-saves> to baseline if settings were written.

steps.title: Start a new game
steps.preconditions: menu-responsive passed; the game is at the main menu; saves target <isolated-config-and-saves> only.
procedure: Choose New Game from the main menu and proceed through any intro to a controllable state.
Record time taken and any errors or stalls.
Capture a screenshot of the first controllable frame.
steps.expected: A new game starts and reaches a controllable state without crash, hang or error dialog.
steps.cleanup_rollback: If the game fails to start, exit by normal means and record fail. Discard the new-game state by resetting <isolated-config-and-saves> to baseline.

steps.title: Player movement and camera
steps.preconditions: new-game passed and the player is controllable.
procedure: Walk forward, backward and sideways; turn and look; jump if available.
Check for input lag, stuck keys, falling through the world or camera glitches.
Record a short capture or notes of the movement.
steps.expected: Movement and camera respond to input smoothly with no crash, freeze or collision failure.
steps.cleanup_rollback: Stop input and return to a safe state; if the game is unstable, exit by normal means. No persistent state outside <isolated-config-and-saves> may remain.

steps.title: Rendering of world and UI
procedure: Observe world geometry, textures, lighting, HUD and menus for corruption, missing assets or black/flickering frames.
Confirm the display mode matches platform.display_mode.
Capture at least one screenshot of the world and one of the UI.
steps.expected: World and UI render correctly and stably; no severe corruption, flicker or black screen.
steps.cleanup_rollback: No state to roll back beyond the isolated profile; copy screenshots to the private evidence location before any profile cleanup.

steps.title: Audio playback
steps.preconditions: new-game passed; platform.audio_device is recorded and volume is at a safe level.
procedure: Listen for music, ambient sound, effects and speech as available.
Check for stutter, silence, distortion or crashes on audio events.
Note audio observations; do not retain recordings of game assets.
steps.expected: Audio plays on the recorded device without crash, stutter or distortion.
steps.cleanup_rollback: Restore the system volume and any audio device setting changed for the test; nothing outside <isolated-config-and-saves> should remain changed.

steps.title: Save a game into the isolated location
steps.preconditions: movement, render and audio have results recorded; saves are directed to <isolated-config-and-saves>.
procedure: Save through the in-game menu using a new unique save name (include record_id).
Confirm the save file appears only inside <isolated-config-and-saves>.
Record the save name, size and hash (no contents) and the player state noted before saving (position and one inventory item).
steps.expected: Save completes without error; one new save file exists only in the isolated location; no pre-existing user save was written or overwritten.
steps.cleanup_rollback: If a save was written anywhere else, stop, restore from the backup and record fail. Otherwise the save stays in the isolated profile until the cleanup-rollback step.

steps.title: Reload the save created in this run
steps.preconditions: save-game passed; the save to load is the one created in this run, never a pre-existing user save.
procedure: Change the player state (move and alter one inventory item).
Load the save created in save-game from the in-game load dialog.
Compare the loaded state to the state noted before saving.
steps.expected: The save loads without error and the state matches what was saved.
steps.cleanup_rollback: Do not load or overwrite any other save. If loading fails or corrupts state, exit by normal means and keep the isolated profile for analysis.

steps.title: Load the same save via the main menu
steps.preconditions: reload-save passed; the game can return to the main menu (or be cleanly restarted with the same isolated profile).
procedure: Return to the main menu or exit cleanly and relaunch as recorded.
Choose Load Game from the main menu and select the save created in this run.
Confirm the loaded state matches the saved state.
steps.expected: The save created in this run loads from the main menu with matching state and no error.
steps.cleanup_rollback: Pick no other save. Exit by normal means; keep the isolated profile intact for the verification step.

steps.title: Clean exit after gameplay
steps.preconditions: load-game-from-menu passed and the game is running.
procedure: Exit through the in-game menu or window close; do not use forced termination.
Record the exit code, time to exit and whether any crash dialog or lingering process appeared.
List files changed or created in <isolated-config-and-saves>.
steps.expected: Process exits cleanly within the time limit; no lingering processes; only expected files written in the isolated location.
steps.cleanup_rollback: If the process did not exit, end only that process by normal OS means and record fail. Do not modify the isolated profile further before the verification step.

steps.title: Verify original install and user data are untouched
steps.preconditions: clean-exit has a result recorded; baselines from preflight-backup-and-isolate exist.
procedure: Re-hash the original game executable and compare it to the baseline; set owned_inputs.original_executable_left_unchanged_verified.
Compare existing user configuration and saves to the backup/baseline; set isolation.existing_user_config_and_saves_untouched_verified.
Record isolated profile contents as names, sizes and hashes only (no contents, no private paths).
Confirm no junctions, asset copies, Steam stub or protection bypass were used.
steps.expected: Original executable and existing user config/saves match their baselines; isolated profile contents are recorded.
steps.cleanup_rollback: If anything differs, do not run further tests: restore changed items from the backup, record fail and list it in summary.blocking_issues.

steps.title: Cleanup and rollback
steps.preconditions: Verification step finished; the isolated-profile retention policy is decided and recorded in notes.
procedure: Restore from the backup any user configuration or saves that were changed.
Delete or retain <isolated-config-and-saves> according to the recorded policy; delete only items created in this run.
Remove temporary files and confirm no test processes remain.
Keep the backup until the owner confirms it can be removed; finalize summary and re-validate the record.
steps.expected: System state matches the pre-test state apart from the retained evidence; summary is complete.
steps.cleanup_rollback: This step is the rollback. If restoration fails, stop, leave the backup and isolated profile untouched, record blocked with notes and report to the owner.
